raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Commit DE-398 (2026-01-16) changed silver_transactions.txn_date to CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE). Ingest occurs about a day after the transaction (e.g., txn_ts 2026-01-15 06:02 arrives in batch 11 with ingest_ts 2026-01-16 02:00), so txn_date no longer matches the transaction date, and the 4630 mismatches equal the POSTED row count. Deriving txn_date from CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) restores the DATE_CONSISTENCY invariant, and the gold tables rebuild from silver in the same run.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
